title: Mode 6 verification: WIN-002 Sentman 1995 citation DOI 404 (broken external link)
summary_1line: Sentman 1995 handbook chapter DOI 10.1007/978-3-662-03137-4_11 resolves to HTTP 404; propose replacement with Sentman 1990 JATP DOI already cited elsewhere on the site.

problem.what: WIN-002.detail_evidence contains an external citation link https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-662-03137-4_11 (label: "Sentman, 1995, in Volland Handbook of Atmospheric Electrodynamics") that resolves to HTTP 404 on both doi.org and link.springer.com. The DOI prefix 10.1007 is Springer-Nature, but Volland (ed.) Handbook of Atmospheric Electrodynamics (1995) is a CRC Press publication (ISBN 0-8493-8647-0), so the DOI is structurally wrong — probably a transcription/AI-fabrication error from an earlier drafting pass.
verified_by_curl: curl -sIL https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-662-03137-4 → HTTP/2 404 (the parent-book DOI also does not resolve — confirms the whole DOI is misattributed)
problem.reader_impact: Reader who follows the link to check our Sentman-1995 citation lands on a 404 page. Undermines credibility of a load-bearing scientific rebuttal (Sentman 1995 is our authority for the claim that standard physics reproduces 7.83 Hz and all five Schumann harmonics in a spherical shell with measured ionospheric σ(h) — no dome required). This is the WIN-002 argument's primary standard-physics anchor.
problem.scope: Single occurrence: WIN-002.detail_evidence, one <a href> link. The unlinked text mention "Sentman (1995) reproduces 7.83 Hz" in the sentence immediately before is unaffected. No other WIN references this DOI (verified: grep count = 2 across all of wins.json, both in this same WIN-002 detail_evidence — the sentence and the link).

other_sentman_refs_in_wins_json.status: DOI 302→403 valid resolution (auth-wall content, DOI itself works)

cross_verify.conclusion: Only the Sentman-1995 handbook-chapter DOI is broken. All other external Sentman/Nickolaenko citations resolve.

replacement_primary.recommendation: Repoint the broken 1995 handbook-chapter link to the Sentman 1990 JATP paper, which makes the same theoretical point (Schumann resonances reproduced by standard ionospheric physics with measured conductivity profiles), is already cited elsewhere on the site (WIN-002 later paragraph), and has a working DOI.
replacement_primary.find: See Sentman, 1995, in Volland Handbook of Atmospheric Electrodynamics and Section 2.1.
replacement_primary.replace: See Sentman 1990, J. Atmos. Terr. Phys. (extended in Sentman 1995, in Volland Handbook of Atmospheric Electrodynamics, CRC Press, ISBN 0-8493-8647-0) and Section 2.1.
replacement_primary.rationale: Keeps the 1995 handbook citation (as historical/expository reference) but points the reader-navigable link to a peer-reviewed DOI that actually resolves. Also matches the citation style used in WIN-002's later paragraph on Sentman 1990.

replacement_fallback.recommendation: If the operator prefers to keep the 1995-specific citation prominence, replace the URL with a WorldCat link for the handbook.
replacement_fallback.rationale: WorldCat resolves to the actual handbook record with ISBN, publisher (CRC Press), and library-catalog data. Not as good as a chapter-level DOI, but definitively resolves and is more informative than a 404.

devils_advocate.counter_1: Is the DOI a temporary Springer routing hiccup, not a structural error? — No. link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-662-03137-4 (the parent-book URL) also 404s, and Volland (ed.) Handbook of Atmospheric Electrodynamics is definitively a CRC Press publication (ISBN 0-8493-8647-0, first edition 1995, 2nd volume same year), not Springer. There is no plausible reason for a Springer DOI to exist for a CRC Press book. The DOI is misattributed at the source.
devils_advocate.counter_2: Does swapping in the 1990 JATP paper change the scientific claim? — No. The 1990 JATP paper is the primary peer-reviewed foundation for the same theoretical treatment (approximate Schumann resonance parameters for a two-scale-height ionosphere); the 1995 handbook chapter is a more comprehensive review by the same author. Cited together they are the standard reference chain in the literature.
devils_advocate.counter_3: Would deleting the link (leaving "Sentman 1995" as plain-text citation) be safer than repointing? — Possible but weaker. A plain-text citation forces the reader to search independently, whereas the current site style relies on inline resolvable links for verifiability. The primary recommendation preserves the reader-verification affordance while fixing the 404.
